annotations.title: Comment on a feature request or issue

description: Adds context to an existing feature request or issue: your use case, another failing request id, a workaround. Prefer it (with upvote_feedback) over filing a near-duplicate. You then get its status emails; its author gets a daily digest of comments. Free; needs a key; 50 comments per account a day. Feature requests are public (never the author's email); issues are private to you and the team. Do not include API keys, personal data or customer data. Needs an API key or a connected account.

id.description: The item's id from list_feedback, request_feature or report_issue (e.g. 42).
